checks_detail.details: 0-based index (0..19). Reads internal software committed frequency float at 0x13eec + 0x5c + index*12 (0x13f48 + index*12); returns utrunc.s(float). No PLL hardware sampling or physical frequency measurement.
checks_detail.label: handler-software-state

checks_detail.details: Returns (byte[0xcee0 + 0xf7] - byte[0xcee0 + 0xd] - 1); state index delta, NOT a frequency measurement.
checks_detail.label: handler-df-query-not-frequency

domain_map.mapping: Existing fabric-domain evidence provides SMN apertures/group assignments but marks physical domain meaning unknown without runtime confirmation.

firmware_query.mapping: Queue0 0x11 handler 0x2EA74 returns an internal committed-frequency float indexed through the 20-domain table; Queue0 0x13 returns a P-state index delta/count.

host_driver.mapping: SMU_FCLK and SMU_MCLK select METRICS_CURR_UCLK; that metric reads Current.MemclkFrequency; gpu_metrics current/average UCLK and FCLK also copy MemclkFrequency.

limits: No new parser or dependency; no firmware/hardware/telemetry action.
This check does not resolve GDDR6 edge/data-rate conversion, actual physical domain identity, training range, or synchronization.

smallest_offline_discriminating_check.interpretation: The available host metrics are aliased software values, and the available firmware clock query is software committed state. Neither supplies an independent MCLK/UCLK/FCLK physical mapping.
smallest_offline_discriminating_check.method: Exact source-fragment alias check plus retained byte-verified handler/domain-result assertions; no sysfs or live telemetry.
